summary.overview: Fleet Pi has strong agent instructions with CI self-validation, comprehensive deployment gates, and a well-configured local development environment. All previously identified findings have been resolved: E2E smoke tests now run in CI, auth/RLS code paths are protected by CODEOWNERS reviewers, daytona skill dead references removed, and pi-protocol included in pre-commit ESLint.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md is comprehensive and self-validates in CI; DESIGN.md, ADRs, and architecture docs provide authoritative context. No session evidence confirms runtime application.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Devcontainer, pinned pnpm, turbo orchestration, and documented commands make startup reproducible. Permission boundaries are stronger with CODEOWNERS entries for security-critical paths.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: Local feedback is fast (watch, pre-commit, turbo cache), CI gates lint/typecheck/test in parallel, and E2E smoke tests now run on every PR. Pre-commit ESLint covers all workspace packages including pi-protocol.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Release gate verifies trust-zone contracts, migration probes, and Neon preview branches per PR. CODEOWNERS requires explicit review for auth/RLS changes. No documented rollback procedure beyond standard git revert.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: Fourteen project memories and 31 skills configured with clean integrity. Session evidence shows some activity but no complete task episodes observed yet. No comparable observation window exists.
